name: Data Export
description: Exports data in various formats like PDF, DOCX, CSV, and XLSX.
project_description: Data Export is a small admin utility that lets a site administrator dump rows from the site's database into a downloadable PDF, DOCX, CSV, or XLSX file. It exposes two admin forms under Admin > Content: 'Export Using Table Name', which lists the columns of a named database table (read from information_schema.columns) as checkboxes and exports the selected columns, and 'Export Using Code', which runs a hand-written SQL query and exports the result set. A third route renders a listing of the two export options. All export work runs through a single DataExportService plus a set of procedural helper functions in data_export.module that build the file with TCPDF (PDF), PhpOffice\PhpWord (DOCX), PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet (XLSX), or fputcsv (CSV) and stream it to the browser. The module ships no config, no config schema, no permissions of its own, and no Drush commands; every route is gated by the core 'administer site configuration' permission. The three PHP writer libraries (phpoffice/phpspreadsheet, phpoffice/phpword, tecnickcom/tcpdf) are hard runtime requirements but are not declared in a composer.json, so they must be required manually. Front-end assets (DataTables, Bootstrap, Font Awesome) are loaded from public CDNs.
